title: US Army to stand up command for unmanned and autonomous warfare
key_facts: An Army memo dated 1 Oct 2026 and signed by Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle directs the Army vice chief of staff to establish the US Army Futures and Autonomous Systems Command (FASCOM).

The memo also creates a Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Autonomy with single authority over buying the Army's priority autonomous systems; the Army reorganized its weapons buying last year under six portfolio acquisition executives.

It tells the Army to prioritize buying and fielding autonomous systems no later than fiscal 2028, including artillery, combat vehicles, watercraft resupply, breaching systems, reconnaissance and drones or robots working with crewed vehicles.
The memo does not say who will lead FASCOM, where it will be based or when it will start; an Army spokesperson said specifics will be announced at a future date.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced the four-star Autonomous Warfare Command (AutoWarCom) in his 30 Sep 2026 address at Quantico; his Project Agincourt memo sets a goal of establishing it by 1 Oct 2027 and says it needs an act of Congress.
The memo does not explain how FASCOM relates to the Army Transformation and Training Command (T2COM) or to AutoWarCom, and the Army gave no information on how the changes will be paid for.
quote_evidence: The memo does not say who will lead FASCOM, where it will be based or when it will be established.
Hegseth announced the Autonomous Warfare Command, or AutoWarCom, during his Sept. 30 State of the Force address at Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia, Military Times reported.
Powers like those require an act of Congress, which gave U.S. Special Operations Command a similar setup when it was created in 1987.
why_it_matters_hint: The Army is reorganising its units, buying and training around drones and robots, though the command's leader, base and start date are not set.
event_date: Memo dated 1 Oct 2026; Hegseth's address 30 Sep 2026; Military Times report 13 Oct 2026.
notes: Robot-war story. The memo was reported by Military Times on 13 Oct 2026 (the Army said it in its release), so freshness NEW.
